name: PCB_STITCH_RADIUS

name: XIAO_RADIUS
note: Retired in rev 3 (2026-11-23): XIAOs moved inside the core (XIAO_CENTRE_V). Rev 2: XIAO centres at r 70 on the core corners, USB-C out to the rim

name: XIAO_PIN_ROW
note: castellated pin rows +- this from the XIAO centre line (0.6 in rows), 2.54 mm pitch, 7 per side

name: J1_V
note: Retired in rev 3 (2026-11-23): J1 is a 4-pin PH at J1_POS. Rev 2: 7-pin J1 pin row along the 60 deg corner

name: BAND_R
note: Retired in rev 3 (2026-11-23): every net runs inside the core. Rev 2: signal arcs round the deck between the antenna holes

name: TRACK
note: signal track width

name: TRACK_5V
note: +5V tracks (rev 3: +5V is tracks only, no pour)

name: CLEARANCE
note: copper clearance (PCBWay standard is 0.15 at 1 oz)

name: VIA
note: via pad and drill

name: PIGTAIL_BEND
note: pigtail bend past the tie toward its sector's holes (silkscreen arrow only)

name: M3_PAD
note: GND copper ring round each M3 hole, both sides

name: CLEARANCE_5V
note: +5V copper clearance to every other net (custom DRC rule, out/*.kicad_dru)

name: GND_BACKOFF_5V
note: bottom GND pour held this far back from every +5V pad

name: FACE_W
note: face PCB width (= FACE_WIDTH); height FACE_H. Solid copper both sides, one RP-SMA hole at the centre

name: FACE_EDGE_EXPOSE
note: exposed copper along all four face edges, both sides (seams to the other faces, the deck and the end plate)

name: FACE_TABS
note: tab centres along each face's bottom edge, from the face centre (user 2026-11-21: tabs and slots to key the faces to the deck)

name: TAB_W
note: tab width along the face edge; tab length = plate thickness (1.6) so it ends flush with the deck top and the end plate's outside. Tabs on both ends (2026-11-22)

name: SLOT_W
note: deck slot width for a 1.6 mm face (FR-4 is +-10 %, so up to 1.76 mm)

name: SLOT_L
note: deck / end plate slot length. A 2.0 mm slot has R 1.0 ends, so an 8.0 x 1.6 tab needs >= 8.8; 9.4 keeps 0.2 mm at +-0.2 fab tolerance on tab and slot and cuts slide play from +-0.8 (10.4) to +-0.3 mm (2026-11-22)

name: MOUNT_GAP
note: tie-mount squares must stay this far from slots, the pipe hole, M3 holes and pads (checked by tie_check in make_pcbs.py; KiCad DRC can't see silkscreen-only footprints)

name: TAB_RELIEF
note: relief notch beside each tab root: width (>= a 2 mm router bit) and depth into the face, so the bit's inside-corner radius doesn't sit where the face seats on the deck

name: COLLAR_LUG
note: Retired in rev 3 (2026-11-23): no bayonet lugs. Rev 2: lug depth, width at the opening edge, width at the tip

name: SW1_PAD
note: Retired in rev 3 (2026-11-23): service switch dropped. Rev 2: SW1 contact pads

name: SW1_LOOP
note: Retired in rev 3 (2026-11-23): service switch dropped. Rev 2: SW1 U loop

name: SW1_NECK
note: Retired in rev 3 (2026-11-23): service switch dropped. Rev 2: SW1 cut neck

name: C1_CAN
note: Not placed on the rev 3 deck (2026-11-23): the 8 mm dual footprint (11 x 9.2 mm courtyard) has no clear spot inside the core; owner to decide (see pcb/README.md). Rev 2: C1 dual footprint, 8 mm can, SMD 8 x 10 mm pads or radial leads at this pitch, overlapping

name: ENDPLATE_STITCH
note: stitching via ring on the end plate: radius, count

name: ENDPLATE_NUT_OD
note: 1/2 in IPS faucet lock nut, estimated to cover hex / winged / flanged nuts; keep-clear ring is this + 4 mm, both sides

name: KO_CHANNEL
note: knockout: routed channel width; its outer edge is ADAPTER_HOLE (the hole once broken out)

name: KO_BRIDGE
note: knockout bridges: width, count

name: MOUSE_BITE
note: mouse-bite holes across each knockout bridge, on the plate side of it: drill, pitch

name: SWITCH_HOLE

name: SWITCH_R
note: Retired in rev 3 (2026-11-23): service switch dropped. Rev 2: toggle hole radius on the end plate
